nextSteps.text: Open the link to review it. It cannot be signed: ask the agent for a new link later.
Tell the agent when you have signed, or that you lost the link.
Do not wait again: end your turn, showing personMessage and the revert link you gave earlier.
When the person says they signed, call it once more; it returns at once.
For a lost link, or when the person asks for a new one, call this: it gives a fresh link and the old one stops working.

body.personMessage: The revert of run <id-1> waits until <time>, but its link cannot be signed. Ask the agent for a new link later.
